plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE beyond shared time trend
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — which genes change over the four time points in a treatment-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is precisely the interaction term of a 2x4 factorial DESeq2 design (condition x time). The design has 2 conditions x 4 time points (t0..t3) x 3 replicates = 24 samples matching the 24x4 metadata and the 25-column (24 sample + 1 gene symbol) count matrix. Grounded in the knowledge service's full_plan procedure for this exact situation (2 groups, 4 timepoints, n=3/cell, salmon counts, human, interaction=true): QC on library-size/PCA/sample-distance structure, minimal count pre-filter, DESeq2 internal normalization, a full model ~condition+time+condition:time, an LRT against the reduced model ~condition+time to find genes whose time trajectory differs by condition (the primary answer to the question), ashr-shrunken simple-effect Wald contrasts at each time point reported alongside it (apeglm is unsuitable here because the simple-effect contrasts are not single model coefficients — apeglm takes a coefficient only), BH-FDR at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, trajectory clustering of the LRT-significant genes, and pathway follow-up. The knowledge_check tool rejected fgsea (ranked-list GSEA) for the enrichment step in this exact situation — the permitted enrichment method it returned is over-representation analysis with an explicit tested-gene universe — so enrichment is planned as ORA on the LRT-significant gene set against MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome, both staged locally for human. All three replicate cells (n=3) carry an explicit, sourced power caveat: the interaction/LRT test has low power at 3 replicates per cell, and the report states this rather than loosening any threshold to compensate.
